stem:
A square floor tile has area 81 cm². Shreya needs the side length of the tile.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The square roots of 81 are +9 and −9, and −9 cm can be used as the side length of the tile.
The side length produces the perfect square, so the side length is 81 cm.
The side length is 9 cm, the positive square root of 81.
A negative number is an allowed physical side length for this tile.

teacher.key_rationale: 81 = 9², and a geometric side length is the positive root 9 cm. Using −9 omits the positive-length condition. Reversing area and side gives 81 cm. Negative length is outside physical side length.
